To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the accuracy of the shot is statistically significantly influenced by the maximum force of grip of the right hand (r 0,356; p 0,015), left hand (r 00,375; p 00,010), and both hands together (r 0 0,369; p 00.012).
the accuracy and precision in shooting with a pistol from a distance of six meters are influenced by the maximum strength of the hand.
the accuracy and precision in shooting from the CZ99 handgun are positively influenced by the maximum force of both hand grips.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between the accuracy of shooting from official handguns and the strength of the hand.
the influence of the maximum force level of the hand grip on the precision and accuracy of the shooting in the case of shooting from the CZ99 handgun.

the relationship and prediction model of the accuracy and precision, as a motoric task of shooting, and the maximal force of hand grip as an indicator of the general physical hand preparation of the shooters.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the maximum strength of the hand, as a basic physical indicator of the hand, statistically correlates with the accuracy of shooting and inversely proportional to precision, which means that the greater the maximum force of grip, the greater the accuracy of shooting, and vice versa.

, for the purpose of achieving better accuracy and precision of the pistol shot, the maximum muscular strength level of the arm muscles, and more precisely of the muscles of the upper extremity, should be developed.

the maximum force in the hand grip is a significant factor in the accuracy of shooting, and that this factor is a significant predictor of the accuracy of the pistol shooting from the official weapon.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a high level of the maximum force level of the hand grip is a prerequisite for a successful performance of the shooting task, and that the level of the maximum hand grip force is an indicator of the physical preparation of the upper extremity, as a basic prerequisite for the performance of the shooting tasks.

the maximum force in hand grip is a statistically significant predictor of accuracy, i.e., the maximum force of 1.00 N in the hand grip increases the accuracy of shooting by 0.019, and the accuracy of 1.000 increases the accuracy of the shot by 0.134.
the accuracy and precision in pistol shooting is statistically significant influenced by the strength of the arm and hand.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the accuracy and precision in pistol shooting are significantly influenced by the level of strength of the upper limbs, which is reflected in the results of the measurement of maximum muscle strength of hand flexors.
it is important to include training in the development of strength of the upper limbs, and especially in the training of the hand grip muscles.

the maximum force level of the upper extremity, which is a basic indicator of physical hand preparation, is statistically significant and positively affects the accuracy and precision in shooting from the official handgun CZ 99.
